test_cases.description: Verify that build_afspec_from_triage returns a fully populated Spec with all four top-level fields set when given a valid TriageResult.
preconditions: A TriageResult with at least one AcceptanceCriterion is constructed in memory
test_cases.expected: Returned object is an afspec Spec instance; spec.requirements is a Requirements object with one Requirement; spec.test_spec is a TestSpec object with one TestCase; spec.tasks is a Tasks object with one TaskGroup; spec.prd is a PRDDocument instance — all fields populated, no exceptions raised.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
spec = build_afspec_from_triage(triage_result, 42)
assert isinstance(spec, Spec)
assert spec.requirements is not None
assert spec.test_spec is not None
assert spec.tasks is not None
assert spec.prd is not None
assert len(spec.requirements.items) == 1
assert len(spec.test_spec.items) == 1
assert len(spec.tasks.groups) == 1

test_cases.description: Verify that build_afspec_from_triage performs no file system access, no afspec.load_spec() calls, and no afspec.save() calls.
preconditions: File system monitoring or mock patching is available (e.g. unittest.mock.patch on builtins.open, afspec.load_spec, afspec.save)
test_cases.expected: No calls to builtins.open, afspec.load_spec, or afspec.save occur during the call; the function returns successfully.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with patch('builtins.open') as mock_open, patch('afspec.load_spec') as mock_load, patch('afspec.save') as mock_save:
    spec = build_afspec_from_triage(triage_result, 1)
    assert mock_open.call_count == 0
    assert mock_load.call_count == 0
    assert mock_save.call_count == 0
    assert spec is not None

test_cases.description: Verify that build_afspec_from_triage is importable from agentfox.nightshift.spec_builder and has the correct signature.
preconditions: agentfox.nightshift.spec_builder module exists on the Python path
test_cases.expected: Import succeeds; inspect.signature reveals parameters (triage_result: TriageResult, issue_number: int) and return annotation Spec.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
from agentfox.nightshift.spec_builder import build_afspec_from_triage
import inspect
sig = inspect.signature(build_afspec_from_triage)
params = list(sig.parameters.keys())
assert 'triage_result' in params
assert 'issue_number' in params
assert sig.parameters['issue_number'].annotation == int
assert sig.return_annotation == Spec

test_cases.description: Verify that _render_spec_sections is refactored to internally call render_inmemory_spec_sections after loading the Spec from disk.
preconditions: A valid on-disk spec directory exists for testing (e.g. .agent-fox/specs/01_test/)

input.spec_path: path to a valid on-disk spec directory

test_cases.expected: _render_spec_sections calls render_inmemory_spec_sections exactly once with the loaded Spec object; the returned sections are identical to direct render_individual output for the same Spec.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with patch('agentfox.session.context.render_inmemory_spec_sections', wraps=render_inmemory_spec_sections) as mock_render:
    result = _render_spec_sections(spec_path)
    assert mock_render.call_count == 1
    called_spec = mock_render.call_args[0][0]
    assert isinstance(called_spec, Spec)
    assert result == mock_render.return_value

test_cases.description: Verify that for every criterion at index N, the Requirement id NS-REQ-{N}, TestCase id TS-NS-{N}, and Subtask id 1.N all refer to the same source AcceptanceCriterion.
preconditions: TriageResult with three AcceptanceCriterion objects is constructed in memory
test_cases.expected: For N=1,2,3: requirements.items[N-1].id == 'NS-REQ-N', test_spec.items[N-1].id == 'TS-NS-N', tasks.groups[0].subtasks[N-1].id == '1.N', and all three share the same description as the N-th criterion.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
spec = build_afspec_from_triage(triage_result, 5)
for n, criterion in enumerate(triage_result.criteria, start=1):
    req = spec.requirements.items[n-1]
    tc = spec.test_spec.items[n-1]
    sub = spec.tasks.groups[0].subtasks[n-1]
    assert req.id == f'NS-REQ-{n}'
    assert tc.id == f'TS-NS-{n}'
    assert sub.id == f'1.{n}'
    assert req.title == criterion.description
    assert tc.description == criterion.description
    assert sub.title == criterion.description

test_cases.description: Verify that each Subtask's test_spec_refs is ['TS-NS-{N}'] and requirement_refs is ['NS-REQ-{N}'] for its criterion index N.
preconditions: TriageResult with three AcceptanceCriterion objects is constructed in memory
test_cases.expected: subtasks[0].test_spec_refs == ['TS-NS-1'], subtasks[0].requirement_refs == ['NS-REQ-1']; same pattern for indices 1 and 2.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
spec = build_afspec_from_triage(triage_result, 6)
subtasks = spec.tasks.groups[0].subtasks
for n, sub in enumerate(subtasks, start=1):
    assert sub.test_spec_refs == [f'TS-NS-{n}']
    assert sub.requirement_refs == [f'NS-REQ-{n}']

property_tests.description: For any TriageResult with N >= 1 criteria, the returned Spec has exactly N Requirements, N TestCases, and N Subtasks in the single TaskGroup.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate TriageResult with N AcceptanceCriterion objects where N is drawn from integers in range [1, 50]; each criterion has random non-empty id, description, preconditions list (0–5 strings), expected string, and assertion string.
property_tests.invariant_check:
spec = build_afspec_from_triage(triage_result, issue_number=1)
assert len(spec.requirements.items) == N
assert len(spec.test_spec.items) == N
assert len(spec.tasks.groups[0].subtasks) == N

property_tests.description: For any criterion at 1-based index N in any TriageResult, all cross-reference IDs (Requirement.id, TestCase.id, TestCase.requirement_id, Subtask.id, Subtask.test_spec_refs, Subtask.requirement_refs) are mutually consistent.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate TriageResult with N AcceptanceCriterion objects (N from [1, 30]) with random valid field values; enumerate each criterion with its 1-based index.
property_tests.invariant_check:
spec = build_afspec_from_triage(triage_result, issue_number=1)
for n in range(1, N+1):
    assert spec.requirements.items[n-1].id == f'NS-REQ-{n}'
    assert spec.test_spec.items[n-1].id == f'TS-NS-{n}'
    assert spec.test_spec.items[n-1].requirement_id == f'NS-REQ-{n}'
    assert spec.tasks.groups[0].subtasks[n-1].id == f'1.{n}'
    assert spec.tasks.groups[0].subtasks[n-1].test_spec_refs == [f'TS-NS-{n}']
    assert spec.tasks.groups[0].subtasks[n-1].requirement_refs == [f'NS-REQ-{n}']

property_tests.description: For any call to build_afspec_from_triage or render_inmemory_spec_sections, no file system reads or writes occur.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate TriageResult with N AcceptanceCriterion objects (N from [0, 20]); patch builtins.open and track call counts; call both build_afspec_from_triage and render_inmemory_spec_sections.
property_tests.invariant_check:
with patch('builtins.open') as mock_open, patch('afspec.load_spec') as mock_load, patch('afspec.save') as mock_save:
    spec = build_afspec_from_triage(triage_result, 1)
    _ = render_inmemory_spec_sections(spec)
    assert mock_open.call_count == 0
    assert mock_load.call_count == 0
    assert mock_save.call_count == 0

property_tests.description: For any Spec object, render_inmemory_spec_sections returns output identical to what _render_spec_sections produced before refactoring (i.e. the refactored _render_spec_sections delegates to render_inmemory_spec_sections and produces the same result).
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Load any available on-disk spec via afspec.load_spec() to obtain a Spec; call both render_inmemory_spec_sections(spec) directly and the refactored _render_spec_sections(path).
property_tests.invariant_check:
direct_output = render_inmemory_spec_sections(spec)
disk_output = _render_spec_sections(spec_path)  # refactored version
assert direct_output == disk_output
